overview_description.description: Vay is a Berlin-based deep technology company that is on track to launch the first driverless, safety-certified, commercial fleet on European public streets. The company aims to revolutionize urban transportation by enabling remote-controlled cars, offering a safer, more efficient solution for ride-hailing and vehicle-sharing services. Vay’s unique approach blends the advantages of self-driving technology with human supervision to ensure safety and adaptability in complex driving environments. Their goal is to reduce urban congestion, cut emissions, and make mobility more sustainable while providing a seamless transportation experience for users.

about_short_description.short_description: Vay is a teledriving technology company that enables the remote operation of cars, revolutionizing urban transportation.

product.name: Remote Driving Technology
product.description: Technology enabling professional Remote Drivers to operate vehicles remotely via a Remote Driving Station with automotive-grade controls and sensory feedback.

product.name: Driverless Car-Sharing Service
product.description: A commercial service offering electric vehicles remotely delivered and driven without a safety driver, available for short-term rental in urban areas like Las Vegas.

product.name: B2B Remote Driving Solutions
product.description: Tailor-made remote driving technology solutions for automotive OEMs, fleet operators, car-sharing, rental, logistics, and public transport companies.

product.name: Remote Driving Academy
product.description: A training program that prepares Remote Drivers with extensive instruction and certification to operate vehicles safely on public roads remotely.

product.name: Teledrive Station
product.description: A specialized remote control station equipped with automotive-grade controls and displays that enable Remote Drivers to operate vehicles remotely.
